frequency_question: How often do formal agency termination actions successfully issue a final revocation order satisfying strict definitions rather than settling, extending, or renewing?
membership_rule: Includes formal federal Department of Education reviews of national accrediting agencies resulting in an official termination or renewal decision within a defined multi-year window.

cases.name: American Bar Association accreditation review cycle 1990-1996

coverage_note: 5 major high-profile professional or institutional accreditor review cycles examined, with 2 resulting in final revocation orders.
known_gaps: Lower-profile agency renewals that did not reach formal adversarial termination stages are excluded as they do not match the conditional premise of the substantive event occurring.
skeleton: Total formal review proceedings of major institutional/professional accreditors by the US Department of Education resulting in an active revocation challenge.
validity_reason: Administrative procedures governing the Secretary of Education's recognition of accrediting agencies remain stable across these multi-year regulatory cycles.
